summary: The video presents a concise narrative of how Zappos’ guiding vision has evolved. Beginning with a focus on product selection, the company shifted to service, defining service as powering a personal emotional connection with customers, and ultimately moving toward delivering happiness. The speakers emphasize that the vision is continually expanding and that the company must evolve to deliver on behalf of the customer.
title: Zappos Vision Evolution: Selection, Service, and Delivering Happiness
